summary: Resubmitted the validated combined obligation+check product for the deferred snapshot commit-context surface; the previous attempt was rejected only because the final response text carried a prose line before the JSON, not for any content defect. Preflight returns valid:true with no diagnostics. The product opens obligation c-snapshot-install-commit-context: a node that installs a snapshot carrying state the source had committed and applied through index J must publish a commit context at least J, because Raft.CommitIndex() is documented as the committed index and as the basis for the read-index optimisation, while installSnapshot publishes raftState.lastApplied and lastSnapshot from req.LastLogIndex and truncates the log but never writes raftState.commitIndex. Basis: map objects f-commit-index, its append-path producer b-follower-commit-advance, its consumers b-fsm-apply and b-client-apply-verify, and the installing behaviour b-install-snapshot; new binding bind-raft-install-snapshot-commit anchored at raft.go:1814-1951 through the newly declared source s-raft-install-snapshot-decl. Harness check-harness-snapshot.go: a real single-voter leader commits forty entries and snapshots at index 43, then a voter of the same configuration installs exactly that snapshot through the module's own InmemTransport InstallSnapshot path with no AppendEntries inside the prefix; local execution emitted snapshot_committed_at_source (index 43, source commit/applied/last all 43), snapshot_installed (success), and commit_context_observed with commit_index 0, applied_index 43, last_index 43, stats_commit 0, stats_applied 43, node_state Follower. Plan check-plan-snapshot.json asserts commit_index == admit.index (equality coincides with not-below here because the receiver's own last index is the snapshot index), admission alias admit, applicability installed == true, identity fields cluster/op. Counterevidence retained: the map records the follower value as min(LeaderCommitIndex, lastIndex) which could read as intended, and the next heartbeat would advance it in a live cluster; the harness itself PASSes, so this product requests formal execution rather than supplying evidence.
